scientific_integrity: Natural, integral symmetry representation proved for all integer m >= 2; neither the nonequivariant wedge formula nor equivariant homotopy is claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only equal arm length four and the natural subgroup S_m x C2 are addressed.
Finite mod-two and Lefschetz calculations supplement an integral all-size proof.
Unindexed equivalent work cannot be ruled out by bibliographic search.
title: Integral branch-symmetry homology of four-edge theta matching complexes
